headline: SDP @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.59 at STL 4.37, with a projected total of 8.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +1.04 runs while STL moved -0.16, changing the projected margin by +1.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.97, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -23.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Samad Taylor, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Ty France because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
